summary: David M. Knipe is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who held professorships at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, serving as Professor of South Asian Studies and Chair of Religious Studies (attested 1989, also attested 1975 and 1998–2001).
David Matsumoto is a Buddhist studies scholar who served as Director at the Institute of Buddhist Studies (attested 2004) and held a post there attested in 2013.
David N. Keightley (1932–2017) was a sinologist and historian who held a professorship at the University of California, Berkeley, attested in 1985 and 1999.

David N. Lorenzen is an Indologist and historian who studied at Wesleyan, SOAS, and the Australian National University under A. L. Basham, J. G. de Casparis, J. W. Spellman, and J. E. B. Gray. He served as professor at El Colegio de México (1970–2010; emeritus 2019).

David Ownby is a sinologist and historian who earned his B.A. from Vanderbilt and Ph.D. from Harvard. He taught at Southern Methodist University (~1989–1993) and was Professor of History at the Université de Montréal from 1994 to 2023.

David P. Chandler is a historian who studied at Harvard, Yale, and the University of Michigan. He held posts at Johns Hopkins, Cornell, the University of Wisconsin-Madison, and Monash University (~1972–1997).

David P. Jackson, a Tibetologist and Buddhist studies scholar, earned his degrees at the University of Washington under David Seyfort Ruegg, also studying under traditional teachers. He held a professorship at the University of Hamburg from 1992 to 2007.

David Patt is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who completed his Ph.D. at the University of Wisconsin-Madison (attested 1993) under Geshe Lhundub Sopa, and also studied under Geshe Lobsang Tenzin and Geshe Thubten Tandhar.

David Phillip Stanley, a Buddhist studies scholar and Tibetologist, earned his Ph.D. from the University of Virginia under Jeffrey Hopkins and David F. Germano. He served as associate professor of religious studies at Naropa University and Co-Director at Nitartha Institute (attested 2019).

David Pingree (1933–2005) was an Indologist and historian who completed his doctorate at Harvard under Daniel H. H. Ingalls and Otto Neugebauer. He was a professor at the University of Chicago (1963–1971) and Brown University (from 1971).

David R. Kinsley (1939–2000) was an Indologist and religious studies scholar who studied at Drew University, Union Theological Seminary, and the University of Chicago, as well as under Om Prakash Sharma and Virendra Singh. He held a post at McMaster University (1969–2000).

David R. Loy is a philosopher and Buddhist studies scholar who earned his Ph.D. from the National University of Singapore. He held posts at the National University of Singapore (1978–1984), Bunkyo University (1990–2006), and Xavier University (~2006–2010).

David Ralph Quinter is a Buddhist studies and Japanology scholar who earned his Ph.D. at Stanford under Carl Bielefeldt and Bernard Faure, and studied at the University of Tokyo. He became associate professor of East Asian religions at the University of Alberta (attested 2019).
David Reigle is an Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology scholar who studied at the University of California, Santa Barbara, and held a post attested at Asian Humanities Press in 2006.
David Ruddell (1943–2015) was a scholar of Indology and linguistics who studied at Laval University and served as Secretary at Fort William College.

David Schaberg is a sinologist who studied at Stanford and earned his Ph.D. at Harvard (~1989–1996). He joined the University of California, Los Angeles in 1996, serving as dean of Humanities (2012) and senior dean of the college (2020).

David Seyfort Ruegg (1931–2021) was a Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology scholar who studied at the EPHE. He held chairs at Leiden University (1966–1972) and the University of Hamburg (1983–1990), and was a professor at SOAS (~1989–1997).

David Shea (1777–1836) was a scholar of Iranian, Central Asian, and Indological linguistics who studied at Trinity College Dublin (1793) and served as Assistant Professor of Oriental Languages at East India Company College until 1836.

David Shulman is an Indologist who earned his B.A. from Hebrew University of Jerusalem and his Ph.D. from the University of London under John Ralston Marr. He served as professor and director (1992–1998) at Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
David Slakter is an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned a Master's degree at the University of Liverpool by 2012 under the supervision of Christopher Bartley.
